candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, causing POST /v1/reservations 503 and order ReadTimeout, propagating 502 to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs absent; timeout cause (load, saturation, network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory driving 503 reservations, order ReadTimeouts, and 502 checkout responses; gateway metrics show elevated /v1/checkout p95 (~2387ms) and 502s. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Redis-side telemetry is missing, so cause is bounded to redis timeout.
